name: Ningbo Ocean Shipping Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Ocean Shipping Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides shipping services in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. It operates through two segments: Transportation Services, and Integrated Logistics and Agency Services. The company offers near-sea, trans-oceanic, trade, and feeder container shipping services; dry bulk cargo transportation services; and dry bulk freight forwarding services. It is also involved in the shipping agency business, including handling customs declaration, port entry/exit procedures; arranging pilotage, berthing, and loading and unloading; accepting bookings; signing bills of lading and transportation contracts; undertaking cargo transport…
